objective: Signal-library expansion required by book v1's preregistered stop condition (met 2026-10-01 19:25: M0 anchor-window residual IC t 1.16 on U3000, 0.91 on P1000): test whether the year-over-year textual similarity of 10-K filings (Lazy Prices) is an independent, low-turnover residual-return signal for the U3000 book, judged by residual IC before any portfolio test.
target_regime_and_horizon: US equities, research-panel U3000 members (P1000 reported), on the monthly formation dates of t20261001_book_v1 formation_ic.parquet; target = the same factor-neutral 21-session forward open-to-open residual return used for the nine themes in residual-ic-summary.json. The anchor window (formation dates 2024-01..2026-08) decides; the stress window (2017-10..2023-08) is a sign check only, per the recent-market rule. Each firm carries its latest 10-K pair for at most 15 months.
existing_solution_comparison: Original CMN 1995-2014: value-weighted long-short 34-58 bp/month (t 3.59). The commercial Brain dataset (from 2010) sells the measure; Quantpedia with Brain data, 2007-2020 top 1,000: the sign depends on the tone section. S&P 100 replication 2009-2026: null (-0.9%/yr, t -0.5; full-document cosine saturated at a median 0.996). QuantConnect 2020-2026 top 100, long-only: Sharpe 0.558 vs SPY 0.533 (noise). No public large-universe post-2014 result exists, so our measurement fills the gap. SRAF cleaned files stop in 2024 and are 50 GB, so we build one EDGAR parser for 2014-2026 that also serves the forward feed.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the signal still carries residual information in the U3000 cross-section after 2015 (post-publication, after commercialization by data vendors), and whether it is independent of the nine existing themes (rank correlation with the M1 composite < 0.5).
negative_experiments_checked: Registry: dir:lazy_prices_10k_changes was parked on 2026-09-23 because a standalone unlevered long-short (15-25%/yr family) ranked behind levered ETF directions; that reason no longer applies under the 2026-10-01 program, which judges signals by marginal contribution to the book. Related lines tested a different mechanism: H-20260928-17 filing risk labels (8-K DeepSeek scores) and H-20260916-02 news-attention counts. The prior-work audit of 2026-10-01 ranks this direction S2_CANDIDATE P2 with no data on disk. This repository holds no earlier test of 10-K text change.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: The IC stage has no trading. The signal updates once a year per firm (10-K), so its turnover inside the book is far below the 172 bp/yr cost drag measured for v1. Visibility = EDGAR acceptanceDateTime, mapped to the first trading day whose 16:00 ET close is at or after it (attribute_trading_day); the signal enters only at formation dates strictly after that day.
stop_condition: FAIL: no primary candidate meets the PASS or WATCH rule in hypotheses.md; close the direction and record the cause as post-publication decay in our universe. WATCH: extend to 10-Q filings (CMN's other half) as the only next step, preregistered before any 10-Q data. Budget: data pipeline at most 2 exec rounds (T-20261002-03), IC test at most 1 exec round, no Modal spend.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: T-20261002-03 builds 10-K similarity pairs (full document, Item 1A, Item 7; cosine and Jaccard) for the CIKs of U3000 members from EDGAR primary documents, filings 2014-07..2026-09. T-20261002-04 then computes monthly rank IC for the three preregistered cosine candidates against the book's residual target, with Newey-West t (lag 3), a 100-permutation within-filing-month placebo, and the rank correlation with the M1 composite. Its brief is written by a lead round before any similarity value is read.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one of the three cosine candidates meets all of: anchor-window mean rank IC > 0 with Newey-West t >= 2.39 (Bonferroni for 3); stress-window mean IC > 0; anchor IC above the 95th percentile of the placebo; median cross-sectional rank correlation with the M1 composite < 0.5.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: All three candidates have an anchor-window Newey-West t < 1.5 or a negative mean IC, or the best candidate fails the placebo. Then close the direction, with no 10-Q extension.
